rationale: The reviewer identified the plate and run-date confound and showed that a plate-only model reaches AUROC 0.887 (key: ~0.91). They also found 54/60 cases versus 8/60 controls on plates 1-2 (90% vs 13%, key: ~85% vs ~15%), and proposed randomizing across plates, leave-plate-out evaluation and an independent cohort. They also correctly flagged that a 120-sample case-control study can't support a screening-test claim without realistic prevalence and early-stage analysis, which the key doesn't mention.
